entities.name: Table T10 - Automotive Industry LTM US Light Vehicle ATP and Incentives Trends
entities.brief: Shows LTM ATP and incentive trends from Dec 2014 to Jun 2025
entities.description: Displays the trend of US light vehicle transaction prices rising and incentives peaking then recovering

properties.key_insight: LTM ATP rose from ~$33k to ~$49k by Jun-25, while incentives peaked near $4.1k in mid-2020, dipped to ~$1.5k by mid-2022, and recovered to ~$3.5k by Jun-25
